name: bench-slack
description: Relay messages through BenchAGI's tenant-bound Slack delivery service. Every outbound call requires approval_id for a live, payload-bound human relay approval; the server returns only after Slack accepts the message.

tools.name: slack_session_create
tools.description: Open a Slack relay session, resolve the recipient (Bench UID, email, or Slack mention), post the first DM, and return a session_key for follow-ups. The request must include approval_id for the dedicated payload-bound human approval. Optional idempotency_key lets the caller choose a stable retry key.

body_schema.message: string (first message text; supports Slack mrkdwn)
body_schema.agent: string (signed agent capability, such as 'aurelius' or 'sage')
body_schema.approval_id: string (dedicated approved relay record bound to this payload)

tools.name: slack_session_send
tools.description: Send a follow-up into the existing Slack thread. The delivery is atomically claimed and reconciled by idempotency_key before a retry can post again. Every request requires approval_id for a payload-bound human approval.

body_schema.approval_id: string (dedicated approved relay record bound to this payload)

tools.name: slack_history
tools.description: Read recent messages from the Slack thread owned by the caller's relay session. Messages are returned oldest first; arbitrary channel history is never exposed.
